name: Rhys Llewellyn
bio:
Rhys's passion for motorsport ignited during his childhood, spent glued to rally broadcasts in the Welsh valleys. He honed his marketing skills through a degree in Communications and practical experience at local racing events. Rhys joined CLRT by Almeras two years ago and quickly became integral to the team's brand strategy.

He believes in a data-driven, yet creatively infused, approach to marketing. Rhys is always eager to implement innovative campaigns to boost team visibility and fan engagement. His flexibility allows him to adapt to the fast-paced nature of motorsport, and his enthusiasm is contagious within the team.

What distinguishes Rhys is his knack for spotting emerging trends and translating them into effective marketing strategies. He's not afraid to experiment, and his understanding of the team's core values ensures that all campaigns stay true to CLRT by Almeras' identity.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly styled with a slight side part
physical.description: Rhys is of average height with a lean build and a friendly, approachable demeanor.

quirks: Always has a stash of Welsh cakes in his desk drawer.
Prefers to conduct brainstorming sessions while walking around the paddock.
Keeps a detailed spreadsheet of every marketing campaign's ROI.
